policies.text: Standard account activation is granted to an applicant with baseline client onboarding approval and confirmed executive background checks.
Direct settlement gateway connectivity is granted to an applicant with low-risk regulatory standing and a verified SWIFT membership code.

Governance threshold compliance is met by submitting 40 or more quarterly regulatory disclosures per year, conducting 10 or more annual internal risk reviews per year, or securing a credit rating score of 80 or above.
Primary banking tier status is assigned when an entity holds an active Tier-1 Banking License.
Organizational capacity compliance is recognized when an entity records annual turnover of $10,000,000 or more, employs 10 or more compliance staff, or maintains 3 or more international licenses.
Fiduciary liquidity certification requires maintaining an annual corporate escrow balance of at least $5,000,000 per year.

High-volume processing status is conferred if an enterprise employs 10 or more compliance staff, has information technology security validation, and handles client transaction velocity of at least 500 operations per day, or holds an active Tier-1 Banking License.
Brokerage master agreements are executed for any firm possessing prime brokerage eligibility.
International transaction routing is authorized for an applicant with organizational capacity compliance that carries an indemnity bond of at least $15,000,000.
Multi-jurisdictional operating approval requires holding at least 3 international operating licenses.
Low-risk regulatory standing is granted to an applicant with high-volume processing status that records an independent AML audit with zero major findings.
Advisory capacity sufficiency is established when a company maintains 20 or more registered investment advisors.
Gateway operator qualification is awarded to a firm holding a certified Payment Service Provider license.
Prime brokerage eligibility is awarded to an applicant with direct settlement gateway connectivity that meets governance threshold compliance.
Information technology security validation is granted when an enterprise holds an active ISO 27001 accreditation.
Baseline client onboarding approval occurs when an applicant has information technology security validation and holds corporate capital of at least $3,000,000.
Institutional management status is conferred when an enterprise handles an annual total asset management volume of at least $300,000,000 per year.
Foreign currency exchange facilities are extended to trading desks providing an external solvency evaluation.
Omnibus account allocation is granted to an entity with multi-jurisdictional operating approval.
Collateralized lending permissions are extended to hedge funds providing cash reserves of at least $100,000,000.
